name: forma
description: FORMA — AI-powered fitness and wellness app with a secure admin console

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-forma "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-forma "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-forma --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.build:free: EXPO_PUBLIC_SERVER_FEATURES=off EXPO_PUBLIC_STORAGE_ENABLED=off npm run build:mobile:web && NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_FEATURES=off npm run build:admin && npm run build:hosting
